definitions.latency_population: initial attempts (attempt 1) that received an HTTP response; end-to-end latency from gen.jsonl
definitions.unexpected_errors: 5xx other than service_aborted_after_acquire outside every fault window [start_ns, end_ns + P], plus transport errors and timeouts
definitions.observation_window: each load step minus its first 5 s, by planned_ns
definitions.allowed_lag: step p99 of sent_ns − planned_ns ≤ 5 ms, an unwritten first attempt above any bound; otherwise the step is generator-limited and gets no thresholds
definitions.latency_threshold: the baseline step's window p99 + 50 ms
definitions.error_threshold: max(0.1 %, 2 × the baseline step's window unexpected-error rate)
definitions.missing_baseline_step: a step that did not run in full with planned entries, or has no latency population, gets no thresholds (missing_steps)
definitions.spike_recovery: deadline = the spike step's end + 30 s; window = [deadline, deadline + 60 s], judged against the post-spike step's thresholds
